_about: Claims deleted from records because they are impossible, not merely unsourced (Nathan, 3 October 2026: 'Anything in that category should be deleted rather than withheld, with a note saying what it claimed and why it is impossible, so nobody restores it later'). check_removed_claims.php fails if any of these sentences is found in a record again; the WordPress file (inventory/wp_content.json) still holds them as they arrived.

claims.title: Father Francisco Garcés
claims.claim: He was beatified by Pope John Paul II on September 22, 1787.
claims.why: Garcés died in 1781, six years before the date it gives (Jerry Reynolds, article #839, gives his dates as 1738–1781), and John Paul II was born in 1920.
